create_heatmap_gt: create a 2D heatmap ground truth tensor from pixel locations with gaussian blur and normalization
obb2voxel: build a 3D voxel grid with centerness, bbox, and class targets from oriented bounding boxes
voxel2obb: convert 3D centerness, size, and rotation voxel grids into ObbTW oriented bounding box objects
compute_focal_loss: compute focal loss for imbalanced classification on predicted and ground truth probability tensors
simple_nms: run approximate non-maximum suppression on a 2D score tensor to remove nearby duplicate detections
